summary_1line: Kunti chooses Pandu as her husband at a royal swayamvara, garlanding him before assembled kings and returning with him to the Kuru capital.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a crowded royal amphitheatre, the shy princess Kunti steps forward and places the wedding garland around the neck of the radiant king Pandu as rival monarchs watch.
Pandu, broad‑chested and resplendent like Indra, stands among rows of crowned kings while Kunti approaches him trembling with emotion.
